python3 - <<'PY'
import pyodide_js

F = pyodide_js.loadPackage.constructor.constructor


def kind(name):
    return F('n', 'return typeof globalThis[n]')(name)


def refused(attempt):
    try:
        attempt()
        return 'ran'
    except Exception as e:
        return 'refused' if 'sandboxed worker' in str(e) else 'other: ' + str(e)[:60]


print('python', sum(i * i for i in range(5)))
print('mount', open('/data/hello.txt').read())
print('globals', kind('process'), kind('global'), kind('require'), kind('fetch'), kind('WebSocket'))
print('nodefs', F('fs', 'return typeof fs.filesystems.NODEFS')(pyodide_js.FS))
print('module-nodefs', F('m', 'return typeof m.NODEFS')(pyodide_js._module))
print('mountNodeFS', refused(lambda: pyodide_js.mountNodeFS('/host', '/opt/host/marker')))
print('loadBinaryFile', refused(lambda: pyodide_js._api.loadBinaryFile('/opt/host/marker')))
print('file-url', refused(lambda: pyodide_js._api.loadBinaryFile('file:///opt/host/marker')))
print('traversal', refused(lambda: pyodide_js._api.loadBinaryFile(str(pyodide_js._api.config.indexURL) + '../../../../../../../../opt/host/marker')))
print('asyncLoad', refused(lambda: pyodide_js._module.asyncLoad('/opt/host/marker')))
print('preload', refused(lambda: pyodide_js._module.FS_createPreloadedFile('/', 'host', '/opt/host/marker', True, False)))
print('lazy-load', refused(lambda: F('fs', 'return fs.forceLoadFile({url: \"/opt/host/marker\"})')(pyodide_js.FS)))
PY
